## Problem
The scheduled Test Suite (mirror) Windows sweep reports `ValueError: the environment variable is longer than 32767 characters` in run 33426859481. Pytest sets `PYTEST_CURRENT_TEST` to `<nodeid> (setup|call|teardown)` for each test. One parametrized test embeds a 60,000-character/75,000-character payload in its generated parameter id, so the Windows environment-variable ceiling is exceeded before the test body runs.

## Root Cause Summary
`tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/mutate/test_outbound_comment_marker_survives_truncation.py::test_undecorated_text_is_byte_identical_to_the_bare_fitter` parametrizes `("label", "text")` with long string values but no explicit short ids. Pytest's default id includes both the short label and the full `text` parameter, producing nodeids measured locally at 60,163 and 75,169 characters. Windows raises `ValueError: the environment variable is longer than 32767 characters` when pytest writes that nodeid into `PYTEST_CURRENT_TEST`.

## Plan
1. Keep the product payload large; only shorten pytest's generated parameter IDs by giving the long cases explicit ids derived from the existing `label` values.
2. Add a regression test in the same module that collects this module's nodeids from `request.session.items`, constructs pytest's real env value shape (`f"{item.nodeid} (setup)"`, also representative for teardown), and passes it through a small test-local `_assert_windows_env_value_fits` seam that implements Windows' documented 32767-character single-env-var ceiling and raises the exact `ValueError` message. This is RED on current code because the collected nodeid itself is too long; it is GREEN only when pytest would stop writing overlong `PYTEST_CURRENT_TEST` values.
3. Verify the sibling set by collecting the module and listing all nodeids over the Windows cap; the repair must reduce the set to zero while preserving the existing large-payload product assertions.
4. Attribute the defect by blaming the long parametrization and citing commit `6724e79e8ff857b54dd36a62006a89445fc10ad6` / `rebar-ticket: 5931-78a3-95d2-44cd`.
5. Run the focused module, a sandboxed mutation check that removes the explicit ids and confirms the new test returns to RED, then `make lint` and the default suite before Gerrit.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] CI run 33426859481's failing test/helper is identified as pytest writing `PYTEST_CURRENT_TEST` for the long parametrized nodeids in `test_outbound_comment_marker_survives_truncation.py`.
- [x] The RED test constructs `PYTEST_CURRENT_TEST`-shaped values from real collected nodeids and fails through `_assert_windows_env_value_fits` with the same `ValueError` text when any exceeds 32767 characters.
- [x] After the fix, no nodeid in that module produces a `PYTEST_CURRENT_TEST` value over 32767 characters.
- [x] The original large-input assertions still execute with the 60,000-character and multiline payloads; only pytest ids change.
- [x] The RCA records the legitimacy verdict, sibling sweep result, and caused-by attribution to ticket `5931-78a3-95d2-44cd`.
- [x] [non-codebase] Mutation check removing the explicit ids makes the RED test fail again inside the sandbox.
